title: MiDM: Minimal Decision Models and an audit of CLM-8B
description: Code and results for a controlled study of small (8B or fewer parameters) typed-decision models. MiDM is a LoRA-tuned causal LM with a pointer head that scores every option line of a question in one pass. The release contains: (1) an exact reproduction and statistical audit of the CLM-8B DeepSWE verifier claim, including a leak check and a 5-seed retrain; (2) controlled experiments with seeds, precision controls and ablations showing that jointly reading the options, the base-model generation at 4B and above, and a balanced data mix drive transfer to unseen sources, while adapter variants, TTA, calibration, ensembles and a second epoch do not; (3) a per-item comparison with TypeSafe Jev on public JevBench items; (4) measured latency for a confidence cascade; and (5) an offline evaluation of MiDM as a best-of-N selector for SQL and code.
